description: Unofficial MCP server for Google Ads: reporting plus safe draft/confirm campaign management.
name: io.github.AleemHaider/google-ads-manager-mcp

environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID from a Google Cloud 'Desktop app' credential
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret from the same Google Cloud credential
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Developer token from Google Ads > Tools & Settings > API Center
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: OAuth refresh token, generated by running `npm run auth`
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: The Google Ads account this server manages (10-digit ID, dashes optional)
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID

environmentVariables.description: Manager (MCC) account ID, only needed if GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID is a client account under a manager account
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
